description.zh: 流程编码。在[流程编辑器](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder)界面查看流程编码。
description.en: The flow code. View the flow code in the [Flow Editor](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder).

descriptions.zh:
- 您可调用此接口删除流程，也可在[流程编辑器](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder)界面手动删除流程。

- 在删除流程之前，请确保您的流程状态为已下线。

- 流程删除后不可恢复，请谨慎操作。
descriptions.en:
- You can call this operation to delete a flow. You can also manually delete a flow in the [Flow Editor](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder).

- Before you delete a flow, make sure its status is Unpublished.

- Deleted flows cannot be recovered. Proceed with caution.
